questions_md:
# Rates - Practice Test - Year 8

Attempt all questions and show your working. Suggested time: 30 to 35 minutes.

## Section A: Consolidating (Questions 1-4)

**Question 1**

A car travels $240 \text{ km}$ in $3$ hours. Find its average speed in kilometres per hour.

**Question 2**

Sam earns \$156 for $8$ hours of work. Find his hourly rate of pay.

**Question 3**

A tap fills a $60 \text{ L}$ laundry tub in $4$ minutes. Find the rate of flow in litres per minute.

**Question 4**

Write each of these as a rate in simplest form.

(a) $300$ words typed in $5$ minutes

(b) \$45 for $3 \text{ kg}$ of cherries

## Section B: Standard (Questions 5-16)

**Question 5**

A supermarket sells yoghurt in two sizes: a $500 \text{ g}$ tub for \$3.20 and a $1 \text{ kg}$ tub for \$5.90.

(a) Find the price per $100 \text{ g}$ for each tub.

(b) Which tub is the better buy?

**Question 6**

Convert $72 \text{ km/h}$ to metres per second.

**Question 7**

Convert $15 \text{ m/s}$ to kilometres per hour.

**Question 8**

Priya counts $18$ heartbeats in $15$ seconds.

(a) What is her heart rate in beats per minute?

(b) At this rate, how many times will her heart beat in $1$ hour?

**Question 9**

A car uses $42 \text{ L}$ of petrol to travel $600 \text{ km}$.

(a) Find its fuel consumption in litres per $100 \text{ km}$.

(b) At this rate, how much petrol will it use to travel $250 \text{ km}$?

**Question 10**

A hose fills a garden pond at a constant rate of $2.5$ litres per minute. Copy and complete the table.

| Time (minutes) | 4 | 10 | ? | 30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Volume (litres) | ? | ? | 50 | ? |

**Question 11**

Electricity costs $32$ cents per kilowatt hour (kWh). A heater uses $2.5 \text{ kWh}$ of electricity each hour it runs. Find the cost of running the heater for $6$ hours.

**Question 12**

Ava runs $400 \text{ m}$ in $80$ seconds. Ben runs $1.2 \text{ km}$ in $5$ minutes.

(a) Find each runner's average speed in metres per second.

(b) Who ran faster?

**Question 13**

A country town has a population of $12\,000$ people and covers an area of $48 \text{ km}^{2}$. Find its population density in people per square kilometre.

**Question 14**

An office printer prints $18$ pages per minute.

(a) How long will it take to print $270$ pages?

(b) How many pages will it print in $2.5$ minutes?

**Question 15**

A file of size $1.2 \text{ GB}$ is downloaded at a steady rate of $6 \text{ MB}$ per second. Use $1 \text{ GB} = 1000 \text{ MB}$. How long does the download take? Give your answer in minutes and seconds.

**Question 16**

Mia says that travelling at $60 \text{ km/h}$ is the same as travelling $1 \text{ km}$ every minute. Show that she is correct.

## Section C: Advanced (Questions 17-20)

**Question 17**

Three shops sell the same brand of coffee beans.

| Shop | Pack size | Price |
|---|---|---|
| A | 250 g | \$9.50 |
| B | 1 kg | \$36.00 |
| C | 400 g | \$14.80 |

(a) Find the price per kilogram at each shop.

(b) Which shop gives the best value?

(c) How much would you save by buying $1 \text{ kg}$ of beans at the best value price instead of the worst value price?

**Question 18**

A backyard swimming pool holds $48\,000$ litres when full. Hose 1 delivers $20$ litres per minute and hose 2 delivers $30$ litres per minute.

(a) The pool starts empty. If both hoses are turned on at the same time, how many hours will it take to fill the pool?

(b) On another day the pool starts empty again. Hose 1 runs on its own for the first $4$ hours, then hose 2 is also turned on and both run until the pool is full. How long does it take to fill the pool altogether? Give your answer in hours and minutes.

**Question 19**

Leo's car has a fuel consumption of $8 \text{ L}$ per $100 \text{ km}$. Petrol costs \$1.95 per litre. He drives $450 \text{ km}$ to visit his grandparents.

(a) How many litres of petrol does he use?

(b) How much does the petrol cost?

(c) What is the petrol cost per kilometre, in cents?

**Question 20**

A leaking tap drips $3 \text{ mL}$ of water every $10$ seconds.

(a) How many millilitres does it leak per minute?

(b) How many litres does it leak in one full day ($24$ hours)?
answers_md:
# Rates - Answer Key

**Question 1**

Answer: $80 \text{ km/h}$ ($240 \div 3$)

**Question 2**

Answer: \$19.50 per hour ($156 \div 8$)

**Question 3**

Answer: $15 \text{ L/min}$

**Question 4**

Answer: (a) $60$ words per minute (b) \$15 per kg

**Question 5**

Answer: (a) $500 \text{ g}$ tub: $64$ cents per $100 \text{ g}$; $1 \text{ kg}$ tub: $59$ cents per $100 \text{ g}$ (b) the $1 \text{ kg}$ tub

**Question 6**

Answer: $20 \text{ m/s}$ ($72\,000 \text{ m} \div 3600 \text{ s}$)

**Question 7**

Answer: $54 \text{ km/h}$ ($15 \times 3600 \div 1000$)

**Question 8**

Answer: (a) $72$ beats per minute ($18 \times 4$) (b) $4320$ beats

**Question 9**

Answer: (a) $7 \text{ L}$ per $100 \text{ km}$ (b) $17.5 \text{ L}$

**Question 10**

Answer: Volumes: $10$, $25$, $75$ litres; missing time: $20$ minutes

**Question 11**

Answer: \$4.80 ($2.5 \times 6 = 15 \text{ kWh}$, $15 \times 32 = 480$ cents)

**Question 12**

Answer: (a) Ava $5 \text{ m/s}$, Ben $4 \text{ m/s}$ ($1200 \div 300$) (b) Ava

**Question 13**

Answer: $250$ people per $\text{km}^{2}$

**Question 14**

Answer: (a) $15$ minutes (b) $45$ pages

**Question 15**

Answer: $3$ minutes $20$ seconds ($1200 \div 6 = 200$ seconds)

**Question 16**

Answer: $60 \text{ km}$ in $60$ minutes, so $60 \div 60 = 1 \text{ km}$ per minute.

**Question 17**

Answer: (a) A \$38/kg, B \$36/kg, C \$37/kg (b) Shop B (c) \$2

**Question 18**

Answer: (a) $16$ hours ($48\,000 \div 50 = 960$ minutes) (b) $18$ hours $24$ minutes (also accept $18.4$ hours; $4800 \text{ L}$ in first $4$ h, then $43\,200 \div 50 = 864$ minutes)

**Question 19**

Answer: (a) $36 \text{ L}$ (b) \$70.20 (c) $15.6$ cents per km

**Question 20**

Answer: (a) $18 \text{ mL}$ per minute (b) $25.92 \text{ L}$ ($18 \times 60 \times 24 = 25\,920 \text{ mL}$)
